# Code security changes newer than the docs snapshot

github/docs does not carry the GitHub Changelog. The bundled `references/` tree is a snapshot (see `upstream_committed_at` in `references/SOURCE.json`), and features often ship, change status or get renamed before the docs catch up.

This list covers 2026-05-31 to 2026-11-28. Where an entry and the docs disagree, the newer dated source wins; say which one you used and read the linked entry for scope and limits before relying on it. For anything after 2026-11-28, check the label feeds:

- https://github.blog/changelog/label/application-security/feed/
- https://github.blog/changelog/label/supply-chain-security/feed/

Older entries are on `?paged=2`, `?paged=3` and so on.
